title: Document studio
idea: Document studio: A stable document canvas with contextual margin tools
audience: People who need to edit document within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: The document is the central work object
avoidWhen: The task is primarily queue triage
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic document layout through its edit document priority and explicit commitment contract: Saving draft and publishing are separate commitments
navigation: Document studio keeps the current edit document context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A stable document canvas with contextual margin tools
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to edit document; the document is the central work object
composition.priority: Saving draft and publishing are separate commitments

imagery.role: Support the actual edit document context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Collapse side panels into explicit drawers at narrow windows
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the document studio structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no edit document content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Saving draft and publishing are separate commitments
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized edit document content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Saving draft and publishing are separate commitments
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active edit document context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
